SUPERSEDED_BY_V3.why: The v2 flow integration DIVERGED. The field was trained on last-token activations only but FlowContext transports every non-special position, so at generation time ||v|| was 11.7 rather than the 1.0 its unit target implies. Because the Euler step is dt*||x||*v, that error compounded.
SUPERSEDED_BY_V3.high_T_cells_are_overflow: At T>=0.10 the residual overflowed to NaN, the model emitted EOS immediately, and every completion came back EMPTY. The empty string was graded GIBBERISH, so the reported gibberish=1.0 at T=0.10/0.15 is 100% arithmetic overflow and 0% coherence judgement. n_graded was 0.
SUPERSEDED_BY_V3.low_T_cells_have_an_UNKNOWN_dose: T=0.02 and T=0.05 did produce real text, but their effective displacement is NOT the 0.0122/0.0304 recorded below. That geometry probe sampled last-token activations only - the one distribution where the field is well behaved - while generation transported all positions. The dose those cells actually received is unquantified and larger, so the refusal numbers cannot be placed on a dose axis.
SUPERSEDED_BY_V3.the_contradiction: This file simultaneously reports a gentle 0.0605 displacement and 100% empty generations at T=0.10. Two irreconcilable numbers in one artifact were the tell.
SUPERSEDED_BY_V3.over_refusal_is_not_a_steering_result: benign_refusal_rate 0.43 is pooled over a benign set where the gate fired on only 2.6% of prompts, so it is ~entirely the base models own refusal rate, not steering-induced over-refusal.
